scope: Source/schema/physics-label review only; no current production results read while execution is active; no viewer or production import/force/tangent/consumer/solver/HP/scatter/geometry-distance/render execution

schema.cached_tangents: Three persisted arrays; read and hash only
schema.matrix: Stored CSC5 format/data/index/indptr/shape fields; no multiplication
schema.state_identity: Original two-array binary64 state hash recomputed from saved bytes, fixed zero displacement checked
schema.task: Literal/canonical task binding and declared ordered targets; genuine chronological indices retained including equal start/end d=0

physics.coordinates: Reference coordinates plus rounded saved L+w for display only; no mechanics or surface distance
physics.actual_panels: Accepted peak and final saved state, geometry x1
physics.supplement: Peak displacement x4; separately labelled DISPLAY ONLY, force arrows omitted
physics.force_units: N; saved actuator and attached support forces ON model; purple saved negative holding resultant ON fixed lower-half body
physics.common_arrow_scale: Same all-path maximum across displayed force fields/body vectors; declared N / display-mm, no half/full-body force doubling
physics.input: Actual b_in nonzero ux DOFs; free mean-input nodes
physics.output: Actual gripper +y nodes shown as measurement diamonds, not forces
physics.displacement: Element mean actual nodal norm in mm; separate solid/medium colorbars share one common all-path range
physics.J: Saved minimum J dimensionless, explicitly not pressure
physics.body: Separate signed material/Hu/total Fx and Fy curves; mirror (Fx,-Fy), full net (2Fx,0), 2absFy scalar magnitude sum clearly distinguished
physics.clearance: Saved bottom/left node-window proxy only; not boundary distance or contact proof
physics.chronology: Newton completed bases separate from line-search trials, trial acceptance separate from path-state acceptance; original residual gate displayed without altered acceptance

bindings: Protocol, actual saved JSON descriptors/NPZ file and raw fields, original HF snapshot, state/matrix, stage source capsules, actual accepted-progress scalar linkage; input SHA before and after. No requalification from current source SHA
limits: Static review does not establish rendered layout legibility; actual render will be independently inspected
Source/metadata hashing checks identity, not independent numerical qualification
P/S finite display fields, auxiliary energy, contact/clamp/pressure, all-column HP and equilibrium are not qualified by this reader
final_author_delta: Stdlib textwrap.fill at drawing only, width54; saved inputs, force units, metadata, chronological curves/CSV and qualification labels unchanged
